description: MAC address reported in the 'versions' message: the server identifies each echo by its MAC address and keys its settings by it, so the server IP, the wake word accuracy and the screen configuration follow the physical device when DHCP gives it another IP. The Echo page now shows the device type, the firmware and library versions, the MAC address and the last time the device was seen. Library 1.2.0, device firmware 1.0.0.

Device and library version reporting over WebSocket: the device sends a 'versions' message (library, device firmware and type) on every connect and answers a 'getVersions' command, so the server can detect which firmware each device runs and push the matching OTA update. The device firmware version is set per entry point through HAConfig::deviceVersion.

Server-driven conversation mode: the server adds a 'conversation' flag to the playAudio command to tell the device whether to keep the microphone open for a follow-up turn (no wake word) until N ms of silence (config: conversationTimeoutMs). No device flag required; the server keeps one LLM session per echo connection for multi-turn memory.
Add support for multiple screens & temperature sensor with 'Echo dashboard' + JSON text commands
add recorded audio into PSRAM buffer before sending to server to avoid problem with network latency. Same for received audio.
new options to set serverip and wake word accuracy through websocket.
